data_description.passive_mode: Only send IR when you change a setting. The same state is never sent again, so the device's own thermostat keeps the temperature.

progress.record: Point the original remote at {remote} and press the button for “{name}” ({position} of {total}). Waiting up to 30 s…

error.controller_changed: Controller changed. Choose where it sends from, then press Submit.
error.controller_target_conflict: Fill the remote entity or the topic / JSON, not both.
error.target_required: Choose where the commands are sent from.
error.repeat_command_unknown: Repeat commands: one of the commands isn't a command of this device. Pick it from the list.
error.repeat_command_duplicate: Repeat commands: a command is listed twice.
error.repeat_times_invalid: Repeat commands: times must be between 1 and 20.
error.custom_name_missing: Custom commands: every command needs a name.
error.custom_name_slash: Custom commands: don't use “/” in a name.
error.custom_name_duplicate: Custom commands: two commands have the same name.
error.custom_name_taken: Custom commands: that name is already a command of this device.
error.custom_code_invalid: Custom commands: a code isn't Broadlink Base64, Pronto or Raw.
error.no_learning_remote: To record a command, this device needs a Broadlink or LinkNLink remote next to its emitter. Paste the code instead.
